info.name: PayFlow MFA Security Verification
info.description: Manual local verification for TOTP enrollment, MFA login, purpose-bound step-up, recovery-code rotation, and destructive MFA disable. The workflow intentionally does not persist plaintext provisioning material, recovery codes, passwords, TOTP values, challenges, grants, or tokens in the committed collection.

item.name: Enrollment
item.description: Start with an active, email-verified account whose MFA state is DISABLED.

request.description: Returns MFA lifecycle metadata without secret material.

exec: const required = ["baseUrl","mfaAccessToken"]; required.forEach(function (key) {     const value = pm.environment.get(key);     if (!value || !String(value).trim()) {         throw new Error(`Set ${key} in the active local environment before sending this request.`);     } });

request.description: Begins enrollment for an active, email-verified account whose MFA state is DISABLED. Read the returned provisioning material directly from the response; the collection deliberately does not persist it.

exec: const required = ["baseUrl","mfaAccessToken","mfaPassword"]; required.forEach(function (key) {     const value = pm.environment.get(key);     if (!value || !String(value).trim()) {         throw new Error(`Set ${key} in the active local environment before sending this request.`);     } });

request.description: Activates pending enrollment using the current six-digit authenticator code. The ten plaintext recovery codes are shown once and are deliberately not persisted by this collection.

exec: const required = ["baseUrl","mfaAccessToken","mfaCode"]; required.forEach(function (key) {     const value = pm.environment.get(key);     if (!value || !String(value).trim()) {         throw new Error(`Set ${key} in the active local environment before sending this request.`);     } });

item.name: Login Challenge
item.description: Run after enrollment is ENABLED. Set a fresh mfaCode before confirmation.

request.description: Performs password authentication for an MFA-enabled account. It expects a challenge rather than access or refresh credentials.

exec: const required = ["baseUrl","mfaEmail","mfaPassword"]; required.forEach(function (key) {     const value = pm.environment.get(key);     if (!value || !String(value).trim()) {         throw new Error(`Set ${key} in the active local environment before sending this request.`);     } });

request.description: Consumes the pending login challenge using a fresh TOTP or one unused recovery code and stores the returned access token only in the active local environment.

exec: const required = ["baseUrl","mfaChallengeToken","mfaCode"]; required.forEach(function (key) {     const value = pm.environment.get(key);     if (!value || !String(value).trim()) {         throw new Error(`Set ${key} in the active local environment before sending this request.`);     } });

item.name: Recovery-Code Rotation
item.description: Run requests in order with a fresh factor proof. Copy returned replacement codes directly from the response.

request.description: Issues one short-lived grant for the exact recovery-code-rotation purpose. Use a fresh TOTP or one unused recovery code.

exec: const required = ["baseUrl","mfaAccessToken","mfaCode"]; required.forEach(function (key) {     const value = pm.environment.get(key);     if (!value || !String(value).trim()) {         throw new Error(`Set ${key} in the active local environment before sending this request.`);     } });

request.description: Consumes the exact step-up grant and replaces the complete recovery-code set atomically. Copy the returned plaintext codes directly from the response; they are not persisted by the collection.

exec: const required = ["baseUrl","mfaAccessToken","mfaStepUpGrant"]; required.forEach(function (key) {     const value = pm.environment.get(key);     if (!value || !String(value).trim()) {         throw new Error(`Set ${key} in the active local environment before sending this request.`);     } });

item.name: MFA Disable
item.description: Destructive workflow. Run requests in order only when MFA removal is intentional.

request.description: Issues one short-lived grant for the exact mfa-disable purpose. Generate a fresh authenticator code before sending.

exec: const required = ["baseUrl","mfaAccessToken","mfaCode"]; required.forEach(function (key) {     const value = pm.environment.get(key);     if (!value || !String(value).trim()) {         throw new Error(`Set ${key} in the active local environment before sending this request.`);     } });

request.description: DESTRUCTIVE: consumes the mfa-disable grant, removes authenticator and recovery-code state, and revokes active refresh-token families. Run only after reviewing the account and response expectations.

exec: const required = ["baseUrl","mfaAccessToken","mfaStepUpGrant"]; required.forEach(function (key) {     const value = pm.environment.get(key);     if (!value || !String(value).trim()) {         throw new Error(`Set ${key} in the active local environment before sending this request.`);     } });
